name: private-tuition-management-system
description: Production-ready Private Tuition Management System for teachers in Bangladesh

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm run build && npx esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=../api/index.js --external:pg-native
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
